name: omle.functions
description: Standard elementwise expression functions for OMLE v0.1.

functions.name: cast
functions.description: Converts x elementwise to the requested target type.
notes: target_type must name a valid OMLE scalar DataType.
Failed conversions yield null or runtime error according to profile; standard v0.1 should prefer null.

functions.name: add
functions.description: Returns the elementwise sum of x and y.

functions.name: sub
functions.description: Returns the elementwise difference x - y.

functions.name: mul
functions.description: Returns the elementwise product of x and y.

functions.name: div
functions.description: Returns the elementwise quotient x / y.
notes: Division always produces a floating-point result, even for integer operands.
Division-by-zero behavior is runtime-defined unless constrained by profile.

functions.name: floordiv
functions.description: Returns the elementwise integer quotient of x divided by y using mathematical floor semantics.
notes: For negative operands, behavior follows mathematical floor division, not truncation toward zero.
Division-by-zero behavior is runtime-defined unless constrained by profile.

functions.name: mod
functions.description: Returns the elementwise remainder associated with floor-style integer division.
notes: v0.1 restricts mod to integer operands. Floating-point modulo may be added in a future version.
For negative operands, mod is defined consistently with floordiv.

functions.name: neg
functions.description: Returns the elementwise negation of x.

functions.name: abs
functions.description: Returns the elementwise absolute value of x.

functions.name: sum
functions.summary: Elementwise sum across multiple numeric arguments.
functions.description: Returns the elementwise sum of all provided numeric arguments.

functions.name: avg
functions.summary: Elementwise average across multiple numeric arguments.
functions.description: Returns the elementwise arithmetic mean of all provided numeric arguments.

functions.name: product
functions.summary: Elementwise product across multiple numeric arguments.
functions.description: Returns the elementwise product of all provided numeric arguments.

functions.name: pow
functions.description: Returns x raised elementwise to the power y.

functions.name: sqrt
functions.description: Returns the elementwise square root of x.

functions.name: exp
functions.description: Returns the elementwise exponential of x.

functions.name: log
functions.description: Returns the elementwise natural logarithm of x.

functions.name: log2
functions.description: Returns the elementwise base-2 logarithm of x.

functions.name: log10
functions.description: Returns the elementwise base-10 logarithm of x.

functions.name: ln1p
functions.description: Returns the elementwise natural logarithm of 1 + x.

functions.name: round
functions.description: Returns x rounded elementwise.
notes: Rounding uses round-half-to-even.

functions.name: floor
functions.description: Returns the elementwise floor of x.

functions.name: ceil
functions.description: Returns the elementwise ceiling of x.

functions.name: sign
functions.description: Returns -1 for negative values, 0 for zero, and 1 for positive values.

functions.name: threshold
functions.description: Returns true where x is greater than the provided threshold value.

functions.name: equal
functions.description: Returns true where x and y are equal.
notes: Equality is exact at the represented dtype level.
The validator must require x and y to be mutually comparable or coercible under the active typing rules.

functions.name: not_equal
functions.description: Returns true where x and y are not equal.
notes: The validator must require x and y to be mutually comparable or coercible under the active typing rules.

functions.name: less_than
functions.description: Returns true where x < y.
notes: The validator must require x and y to be mutually orderable or coercible under the active typing rules.

functions.name: less_or_equal
functions.description: Returns true where x <= y.
notes: The validator must require x and y to be mutually orderable or coercible under the active typing rules.

functions.name: greater_than
functions.description: Returns true where x > y.
notes: The validator must require x and y to be mutually orderable or coercible under the active typing rules.

functions.name: greater_or_equal
functions.description: Returns true where x >= y.
notes: The validator must require x and y to be mutually orderable or coercible under the active typing rules.

functions.name: and
functions.description: Returns x AND y elementwise using three-valued logic.

functions.name: or
functions.description: Returns x OR y elementwise using three-valued logic.

functions.name: xor
functions.description: Returns x XOR y elementwise.
notes: For XOR, null propagates strictly because neither operand alone determines the result.

functions.name: not
functions.description: Returns NOT x elementwise.

functions.name: if
functions.description: Returns then_value where condition is true, else else_value.
notes: Branches are evaluated lazily: only the selected branch is evaluated.
The validator must require then_value and else_value to have compatible types and measure levels.

functions.name: coalesce
functions.description: Evaluates arguments left to right and returns the first non-null value.

functions.name: is_missing
functions.summary: Test whether the input is null.
functions.description: Returns true where x is missing/null.

functions.name: isnull
functions.description: Returns true where x is missing/null. This is an alias for is_missing.

functions.name: is_not_missing
functions.summary: Test whether the input is not null.
functions.description: Returns true where x is not missing/null.

functions.name: map_values
functions.summary: Map input values through explicit key-value pairs.
functions.description: If x is missing, returns map_missing_to when provided, else null. Otherwise returns the mapped value for the first matching from/to pair. If no mapping matches, returns default_value when provided, else null.
notes: pairs are interpreted as from/to pairs.
The validator must require an even number of pair elements.
The validator must type-check pair elements as alternating key/value entries.
The result type is inferred from mapped values plus optional result-side defaults, not from x or key-side pair entries.
If x is missing and map_missing_to is present, map_missing_to is returned.
If x is non-missing and no pair matches, default_value is returned when present.

functions.name: min
functions.summary: Elementwise minimum of two numeric arguments.
functions.description: Returns the elementwise minimum of x and y.

functions.name: max
functions.summary: Elementwise maximum of two numeric arguments.
functions.description: Returns the elementwise maximum of x and y.

functions.name: clip
functions.description: Returns x clamped elementwise to the inclusive interval [lo, hi].
notes: This function has the same scalar semantics as the core Clip operator, but is used inside expressions.

functions.name: concat
functions.description: Returns the elementwise concatenation of x and y.

functions.name: length
functions.description: Returns the elementwise length of x.
notes: Length is measured in Unicode code points, not bytes.

functions.name: lower
functions.description: Returns x converted to lowercase elementwise.

functions.name: upper
functions.description: Returns x converted to uppercase elementwise.

functions.name: trim
functions.description: Returns x with leading and trailing whitespace removed elementwise.

functions.name: substring
functions.description: Returns a substring of x using integer start and length arguments.
notes: start is 0-based and measured in Unicode code points.
length is measured in Unicode code points.
If start + length exceeds the string length, the result is truncated silently.
Negative start or length yields null.

functions.name: in
functions.summary: Test whether a value is in a provided set.
functions.description: Returns true where x matches any provided set member.
notes: The validator must require all set members to be mutually comparable with x or coercible under the active typing rules.
Duplicate set members are allowed but have no additional semantic effect.

functions.name: not_in
functions.summary: Test whether a value is not in a provided set.
functions.description: Returns true where x matches none of the provided set members.
notes: The validator must require all set members to be mutually comparable with x or coercible under the active typing rules.
Duplicate set members are allowed but have no additional semantic effect.

functions.name: dateDaysSinceYear
functions.summary: Return the signed day offset from January 1 of a reference year.
functions.description: Returns the elementwise number of calendar days between x and the start of the given reference year.
notes: v0.1 restricts x to DATE inputs.
The reference point is the civil date year-01-01.
The result is signed and may be negative.

functions.name: dateSecondsSinceYear
functions.summary: Return the signed second offset from January 1 of a reference year.
functions.description: Returns the elementwise number of elapsed seconds between x and the start of the given reference year.
notes: v0.1 restricts x to TIMESTAMP inputs.
The reference point is year-01-01T00:00:00.
The result is signed and may be negative.

functions.name: dateSecondsSinceMidnight
functions.summary: Return the second offset from midnight.
functions.description: Returns the elementwise number of elapsed seconds since 00:00:00.
notes: v0.1 restricts x to TIME inputs.
The result is in the range supported by the TIME value domain.

functions.name: erf
functions.description: Returns the elementwise Gauss error function of x.

functions.name: stdNormalPDF
functions.description: Returns the elementwise probability density of the standard normal distribution at x.

functions.name: stdNormalCDF
functions.description: Returns the elementwise cumulative probability of the standard normal distribution at x.
notes: The result is in the interval [0,1].

functions.name: stdNormalIDF
functions.summary: Elementwise standard normal inverse cumulative probability.
functions.description: Returns the elementwise inverse cumulative probability of the standard normal distribution for p.
notes: p must be in the open interval (0,1).

functions.name: normalPDF
functions.description: Returns the elementwise probability density of the normal distribution with mean and standard deviation at x.
notes: stddev must be greater than 0.

functions.name: normalCDF
functions.description: Returns the elementwise cumulative probability of the normal distribution with mean and standard deviation at x.
notes: stddev must be greater than 0.
The result is in the interval [0,1].

functions.name: normalIDF
functions.description: Returns the elementwise inverse cumulative probability of the normal distribution with mean and standard deviation for p.
notes: p must be in the open interval (0,1).
stddev must be greater than 0.
